nodes.label: Coding Standards & ECS Principles
nodes.rationale: Covers performance first, data locality, custom WebGL lighting compilation (overriding #include <lights_fragment_begin>), and material sharing anti-patterns.

nodes.label: Zero Object Allocation Loop Principle
nodes.rationale: Within the inner rendering and chunk generation loops, never instantiate new objects or arrays. Reuse existing typed arrays.

nodes.label: 32-Bit ECS Standard Principle
nodes.rationale: All voxel data must strictly adhere to the 32-bit integer schema. Do not create individual JS objects for blocks.

nodes.label: Material Sharing Anti-Pattern Principle
nodes.rationale: Do not share ShaderMaterial between Mesh and InstancedMesh. Three.js relies on compilation macros like #define INSTANCED, which are dropped if shared.

nodes.label: Host Authority Principle
nodes.rationale: The Host is the absolute authority for physical block breaking, entity AI, and generation, verifying guest inputs over WebRTC data channels.
